text:
Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x was published by y.
English(x) ::: x is in English.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x was translated from y.
Italian(x) ::: x is in Italian.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Press(y) ::: y is a press.
SpecializesIn(y, z) ::: y specializes in z.
Premises:
∀x (PublishedBy(x, y) → Press(y)) ::: All books published by a press are published by that press.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, y) → English(x)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
NeapolitanChronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
NeapolitanChronicles was translated from Italian.
PalaceOfFlies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
¬PublishedBy(HarryPotter, y) ::: Harry Potter was not published by New Vessel Press.
